purpose: PHD-MAIN-TRAINERR-v1 addendum 6: a cause for every lost point (works ga-ba). Counting only: no training, no method change, no fix tried.
fork_for_rendering: GeoGS-conf-guided-v1-r31 (read only; no new fork, no training)

points.sample_rule: numpy default_rng(rng_seed + scene index in 'scenes'), choice without replacement per group 0/2/3, sorted; all if fewer

point_state.rule: 4 = patch_row < 0; else 2 = spot_n_all > 0 (a Gaussian with opacity >= 0.1 within 0.2 m, addendum2 spot); else 1 = seeds > 0; else 3 (seeds = 0)

names.3: 상태 3. 배치하지 않았고 학습 뒤에도 없다

runs.rule: per scene the record run with the densest whole-scene dumps (trainlog/scene/*.pt); tie -> the one that already has a 30000 mesh scored with the GTJUDGE rule

regroup: target right = A11 reference__judgment_mesh__within_tau1 (as addendum2); result right = record-run 30000 mesh points.npz reference__within_tau1; same 4-group rule; agreement = share of the selected points whose group is the same under both definitions

work_ga.bound: target_tag == 1 and target_index == the point's patch (valid-patch index, Targets.vidx[patch_row])
work_ga.empty_iteration: first dump (in iteration order, pre_reset before post) with 0 bound; 'never' if none; 'empty from 0' if 0 at dump 0
work_ga.refill: a later dump with >= 1 bound after the first empty dump
work_ga.exit: a Gaussian bound to the patch in dump a and not bound to it in the next dump b; one exit per (Gaussian, consecutive dump pair)

paths.release: present in b with target_tag != 1; movement from the release event (scene-wide) of that uid in (a, b] when present
paths.retarget: present in b with target_tag == 1 and another target_index; distance from the point to the new patch anchor; whether the new anchor is within 0.5 m of the old patch anchor
paths.reset_delete: absent in b, not replaced by split, and (delete event reason 1 at iteration R+100 for a reset R) or (no delete event and a = the post-reset dump of R): written '재설정 뒤 <b - R>회 안' (window kept per exit; 500 for dumps every 500, 2,000 for runs with sparse dumps)
paths.other_delete: absent in b, not split, delete event with another reason or iteration, or no event and (a, b] holds no reset check R+100: '그 저장 사이에 없어짐', reason '확인 불가'
paths.delete_window_with_reset: absent in b, no event, a is not the post-reset dump and (a, b] holds a reset check R+100: '재설정이 든 저장 사이에 없어짐', reason '확인 불가' (counted with other_delete for the main path, shown separately)
paths.split: absent in b and a link event how=3 (split) with parent_uid = uid in (a, b]; whether a child is bound to the same patch in b

work_ga.main_path: the most frequent path among the patch's exits (ties: order release, retarget, reset_delete, other_delete, split); 'none' if no exit
work_ga.relock_note: re-locked before any computation (2026-11-17): reset_delete / delete_window_with_reset reworded so sparse-dump runs (post-reset dump 3000 -> next dump 5000) are covered
